title: Pure Nordic
summary: Nordic cards and the Aesir Synchro bosses they are built to summon, with generic Links and staples. There is no separate Aesir page, so Thor, Odin and Loki live here. Each Aesir is a Level 10 Synchro made from one kind of Nordic Tuner (Beast, Ascendant or Alfar). Each one negates or protects on its own and returns from the GY after it falls. Gullveig of the Nordic Ascendant, a Link-1, banishes cards to summon that many Nordics from the Deck. Alviss of the Nordic Alfar, banished that way, sends three Nordics with 10 total Levels to the GY and summons an Aesir straight from the Extra Deck. The 2022 cards lead. Nordic Smith Ivaldi summons itself and searches a Nordic Relic. Nordic Relic Hlidskjalf summons a Nordic from the Deck, and Nordic Relic Svalinn negates their board while you control an Aesir. Hlidskjalf limits the Extra Deck to Aesir.

allow.Thor, Lord of the Aesir: The Nordic Beast Synchro boss; Alviss and Svalinn summon it.
allow.Odin, Father of the Aesir: The Nordic Ascendant Synchro boss; Alviss and Svalinn summon it.
allow.Loki, Lord of the Aesir: The Nordic Alfar Synchro boss; Alviss and Svalinn summon it.
